en.name: Bison
en.summary: Whole cuts of bison — steaks, roasts and joints — keep 3–5 days in the fridge and 6–9 months in the freezer. It is a much leaner red meat than beef, which changes how it cooks more than how it stores.
en.pantry: Raw bison must not be kept at room temperature. It is a fresh red meat and belongs at 4 °C (40 °F) or below at all times; follow the 2-hour rule, or 1 hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Taking a steak out for twenty minutes or so before cooking is fine and helps it cook evenly, but an hour on a warm counter is not, whatever a recipe says about bringing meat to room temperature.
en.fridge: Keep whole cuts at 4 °C (40 °F) or below and use them within 3–5 days of purchase. Store them on the bottom shelf in a container or on a plate that catches drips, below anything ready to eat, and leave them loosely covered rather than sealed tight — a dry surface browns and sears better than a wet one. A whole cut keeps far longer than mince because the bacteria stay on the outside, where the heat of the pan reaches them; that is also why a steak can be served pink and mince cannot.
en.freezer: Bison keeps 6–9 months at −18 °C (0 °F). Wrap each cut airtight with no air pockets, or vacuum-seal it, then bag it — lean meat freezer-burns quickly because there is little fat to protect the surface. Freeze in single cuts or meal-sized portions and label the date. Frozen food stays safe indefinitely at −18 °C; the months are about quality, and dryness is what ends it.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge — allow a day for a steak and longer for a roast — or in a sealed bag under cold running water. Never on the counter. Cook thawed bison within a day or two, and do not refreeze it raw.
spoilage: A slimy or sticky surface rather than a merely tacky one.
A sour, sulphurous or ammoniacal smell instead of a clean metallic one.
A grey-green or iridescent cast over the whole cut, not just a darker face.
A swollen vacuum pack, or cloudy, ropy liquid in the tray.
tips: Keep the surface dry; a dry steak sears and a wet one steams.
Bison is lean, so it cooks faster than beef — pull it earlier than you think.
Vacuum-seal before freezing; lean meat burns quickly in the freezer.

faq.q: How long does bison keep in the fridge?
faq.a: 3–5 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below for whole cuts like steaks and roasts.
Yes, 6–9 months at −18 °C. Vacuum-seal or wrap airtight, because lean meat freezer-burns easily.

faq.q: Why do whole cuts keep longer than mince?
faq.a: Bacteria stay on the outside of a whole cut, where cooking heat reaches them. Mincing spreads them all the way through, so mince spoils faster and must be cooked through.
It is leaner, so it cooks faster and dries out sooner. Storage is the same; cooking times are not.

zh.name: 美洲野牛肉
zh.summary: 整塊的野牛肉——牛排、烤肉塊、大塊肉——冷藏可放 3～5 天，冷凍 6～9 個月。它比一般牛肉瘦得多，但那影響的主要是烹調方式，而不是保存方式。
zh.pantry: 生野牛肉不能放室溫。它是生鮮紅肉，必須全程保持在 4 °C 以下；請守 2 小時原則，廚房超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時。下鍋前拿出來放個二十分鐘左右讓受熱均勻是可以的，但不管食譜怎麼說「回到室溫」，在溫暖的檯面上放一小時就不行。
zh.fridge: 整塊肉放 4 °C 以下，購買後 3～5 天內用完。放最下層、用容器或盤子接住滴液，位置低於所有即食食品；建議鬆鬆地蓋著而不是密封——表面乾的肉比濕的更好上色。整塊肉比絞肉耐放得多，因為細菌只留在外層，而那正是鍋子的高溫碰得到的地方；這也是為什麼牛排可以帶粉紅、絞肉不行。
zh.freezer: 野牛肉在 −18 °C 下可放 6～9 個月。每塊密封包好不留空氣，或真空封裝後再套袋——瘦肉表面沒什麼脂肪保護，很快就會凍燒。請單塊或按一餐的量分裝並標上日期。−18 °C 下安全性是無限期的，月數講的是品質，而終結它的是「變乾」。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍——牛排大約一天，大塊烤肉更久——或密封裝袋用冷水沖。不要放室溫。解凍後一兩天內煮掉，生的不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 表面變得黏滑，而不只是略帶黏手。
聞起來發酸、有硫味或氨味，而不是乾淨的金屬味。
整塊泛灰綠或出現虹彩，而不只是某一面顏色較深。
真空包鼓脹，或盤中的血水變得混濁牽絲。
tips: 保持表面乾燥；乾的才會上色，濕的只會變成用蒸的。
野牛肉很瘦，比牛肉熟得快——比你以為的更早起鍋。
冷凍前真空封裝；瘦肉在冷凍庫裡很快凍燒。
永遠放在即食食品的下層。

faq.q: 野牛肉冷藏可以放多久？
faq.a: 整塊的牛排或烤肉塊，在 4 °C 以下 3～5 天。
可以，−18 °C 下 6～9 個月。請真空封裝或密封包好，瘦肉很容易凍燒。

faq.q: 為什麼整塊肉比絞肉耐放？
faq.a: 整塊肉的細菌只在外層，正好是加熱碰得到的地方。絞碎會把細菌帶進整塊肉，所以絞肉壞得快，也必須煮全熟。

faq.q: 野牛肉的煮法和牛肉一樣嗎？
faq.a: 它更瘦，所以熟得更快、也更容易乾柴。保存方式相同，烹調時間不同。
